climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A northern Rhône appellation south of Côte-Rôtie, making white wine only from Viognier. Its vineyards lie in seven communes, on the steep slopes of the foothills of the Massif Central on the right bank of the Rhône.
